Name: Anthro Characters Continued - Albert Recolor Tune Up
Author: star1s
Description:
[b]I wasn't satisfied with his colors and decided to tune him up a bit, giving Albert colors that pop!
[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/k0079lp.png[/img]﻿
[b]
[/b][color=#e69138]1.[/color] Install the latest version of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1966]Anthro ﻿Characters Continued[/url]﻿ and its requirements.

[color=#e69138]2[/color]. Open ACC's folder, open Assets/Characters.

[color=#e69138]3[/color]. Inside, you will find 5 images meant for Albert. They're named "Albert", "Albert_Beach", "Albert_Winter", "ClothesTherapyCharacters_albert_pose" & "ClothesTherapyCharacters_albert_strut".

[color=#e69138]4[/color]. Take all images named identically to those in my file and replace them with the 5 images in Characters folder. [color=#e69138]I recommend saving Albert's old images in case you mess up/decide to switch back[/color].

[color=#e69138]5[/color]. Head to Assets/Portraits afterwards and replace "Albert", "Albert_Beach", "Albert_Winter" with those in my file named identically.

[color=#e69138]6[/color]. After this, you will also want to head to Assets/LooseSprites. Replace "emojis_characters" with those in my file named identically. Then head to Assets/TileSheets and also replace "junimo_furniture_portraits" with those in my file named identically.

[b][color=#cc4125]DO NOT paste the folders. ONLY the images! You probably need to unzip it to use the images inside.[/color][/b]
﻿

If people end up enjoying this tune-up for Albert, I'll most likely upload more alternatives for the other characters!
